name: desktop-check
description: Screenshot DISPLAY=:1 (xfce4-screenshooter) and READ it: per visible seat view — idle/busy, unsubmitted input text (stranded nudges), last activity, errors — plus desktop leaks; recommends, never acts. Args: {focus}. Authored via workflow.py author (Prime L4-VII, owner 2026-09-11 02:1xZ: the panes stay up, check screenshots as needed).

stages.label: capture-and-read
stages.prompt: You check the live X desktop (DISPLAY=:1) of the agi box by SCREENSHOT — the tmux panes of the seats stay on screen as read-only views. READ-ONLY: never type into a pane, never send keys, never touch tmux, the stream unit (streamer-stub.service) or any window; you look and report. Steps: (1) `mkdir -p /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/sessions/screens` then capture with `DISPLAY=:1 xfce4-screenshooter -f -s /home/ubuntu/work/agi/.agi/sessions/screens/desktop-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).png` (fallback: `DISPLAY=:1 xwd -root -out <path>.xwd` and convert with Python PIL if xfce4-screenshooter is missing). (2) Read the PNG with the Read tool (it renders images). (3) For every visible terminal view report: which seat/window it shows (the title or the prompt line names it), whether it looks idle (an empty `❯` prompt) or busy (a spinner, `esc to interrupt`), any text sitting UNSUBMITTED in the input box (a `❯` line with content and no response below it — the stranded-nudge defect), the last visible activity line, and any error or red line. (4) Also note desktop-level facts: panels visible, hostname/user/clock leaks, popups, a view that is black or missing. Focus from the caller: {focus}. (5) Recommend ONE action per finding (for example `tmux send-keys -t agi-rc:@NNN Enter` for a stranded line) but DO NOT execute any of them — the Prime decides. Return ONLY the structured result.
